name: HueManity
description: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) demonstrate strong high-level visual reasoning on tasks such as visual question answering and image captioning. Yet existing benchmarks largely overlook their ability to capture fine-grained perceptual details. As MLLMs are increasingly deployed in safety and reliability critical settings, perceptual acuity becomes essential. We present HueManity, a scalable automated benchmark for assessing fine-grained visual perception in MLLMs.
